incident.message: ErrImagePull: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone": failed to resolve reference "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone": public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone: not found

classification.rationale: The container failed to pull the image "python:3.12.99-gone" because the image reference was not found in the registry, which is a deployment configuration error preventing the pod from starting.

diagnosis.root_cause: The Deployment web-f36262 was updated to use a non-existent image tag 'public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone'. The registry returns NotFound (manifest unknown) because the tag was never pushed. The new ReplicaSet (revision 2) cannot pull the image, so its pod is stuck in ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff. The previous revision (revision 1) used 'public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12-slim', which was Ready (1/1).

evidence.value: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone": failed to resolve reference "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone": public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone: not found
Failed to pull image "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12.99-gone": rpc error: code = NotFound

proposal.rationale: Revision 1 ran image 'public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.12-slim' and was Ready (1/1). Revision 2 introduced the non-existent tag '3.12.99-gone'. Rolling the image back to the revision 1 image will immediately restore availability. The missing tag '3.12.99-gone' should be built and pushed before the next release attempt.
proposal.risk: Low. Rolling back to an image that was previously confirmed Ready (revision 1, 1/1). The old ReplicaSet and its pod template are still present in history, so Kubernetes will reuse the existing ReplicaSet without creating a new one.
proposal.delivery: Apply as a pull request against /gitops after a human approves it. The agent does not change the cluster.

similar_incidents.title: PM-2026-072: search-indexer rollout stuck on a tag that was never pushed
similar_incidents.fix: Rolled the container image back to the image of the last ReplicaSet revision that was Ready (indexer:2.13.2, revision 41) via a GitOps pull request, then rebuilt and pushed the missing tag before releasing again.
similar_incidents.excerpt: The registry returned `manifest unknown` for the new tag. similar_incidents.title: PM-2026-079: notification-gateway crash loop after a ConfigMap key rename
similar_incidents.fix: Restored the required key SMTP_HOST in the ConfigMap the Deployment loads with envFrom (keeping the new key too) and restarted the Deployment. Clue: exit code 1 with a config error in the previous container log, normal memory and CPU.
similar_incidents.excerpt: The rename was valid YAML and passed review, but nothing checked that the application still found the keys it requires. A second Deployment that used `valueFrom.configMapKeyRef` on the old key failed earlier and louder, with `CreateContainerConfigError: couldn't find key SMTP_HOST in ConfigMap notify/gateway-config`. ## Evidence - Previous container log: `FATAL config: SMTP_HOST is required` then
